'''Jabba's Star''' was a naval base in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] owned by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Description==
Jabba's Star was said to have served as a shining representation of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] cunning and skill with manipulating anything and everything.

==History==
The small outpost provided a point of origin for the Hutt's illegal operations. Unless there was business to be dealt with, Jabba's thugs were not partial to having visitors near the structure.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jabba's Star appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
